comment: Native coin burn test vectors (009-native-coin-burn T008) — the seven boundary cases of contracts/native-coin-burn.md §10, pinned bit-for-bit. A TEST resource: nothing in main reads this file. The share constants name the calibration the expected values were computed against (mainnet's 1/2); every 64-bit quantity is a decimal STRING, never a bare JSON number (the 2^53 JS-precision rule, 002 precedent).

vectors.name: empty block: a zero pool destroys nothing however large the debt
share rounds to zero: a one-base-unit flow is below the floor of the fraction
flow-limited: the share of the pool is the lesser term
debt-limited: the carried debt is the lesser term
exact landing on the target: the debt term equals the share exactly
curve inactive: no coin is destroyed whatever the pool and whatever is owed
at the target: a zero debt clamps the burn to zero
